title: Design framework
outcome: Retrieve the seven-part framework and prioritize risks.

title: Requests, scale, and useful estimates
outcome: Trace a request, separate latency from throughput, estimate capacity with units, and choose a bottleneck from evidence.

title: Data access, caches, and atomic boundaries
book: Chapter 1 data/cache foundations; supplemented by database semantics
outcome: Choose keys/indexes from access patterns, preserve a concurrent invariant, and specify cache freshness/failure behavior.

title: URL shortener: serving and mutable mappings
outcome: Derive a read-heavy architecture, prevent code collisions, and revise caching when links become editable or revocable.

title: Unique IDs: clocks, coordination, and order
outcome: Separate uniqueness from ordering and explain allocation, worker identity, clock rollback, and sequence exhaustion.

title: Distributed rate limiting and overload control
outcome: Choose an algorithm from the exact admission contract, enforce an atomic decision, and handle store/region failure.

title: Consistent hashing, placement, and migration
outcome: Compute ownership and changed placement, distinguish distribution from replication, and preserve reads during migration.

title: Distributed key-value stores and honest consistency claims
outcome: Trace durable read/write paths, explain replicas and quorum assumptions, and reason about partitions, conflicts, and repair.

title: Async workflows, retries, and notification delivery
outcome: Separate accepted/processed/external effects, close the database-to-event gap, and design retries, quotas, and recovery.

title: Crawler scheduling, bounded exploration, and safe fetching
outcome: Design a restartable frontier with per-host policy, explain deduplication limits, and protect the fetch boundary.

title: News feed: projections, fan-out, and privacy
outcome: Choose push/pull/hybrid from follower skew and freshness, design stable pagination, and preserve access on derived views.

title: Chat: durable acceptance, live delivery, and reconnects
outcome: Separate transport from durability, implement retry-safe messages and catch-up cursors, and state presence/order limits.

title: Autocomplete: derived indexes, top-K, and fresh snapshots
outcome: Separate ingestion from serving, choose a prefix access structure, and evolve versioned results with privacy/freshness controls.

title: Video delivery: control plane, data plane, and processing
outcome: Separate media bytes from metadata, publish only ready renditions, and reason about bandwidth, retries, CDN policy, and cost.

title: File sync: versioned metadata and recoverable conflicts
outcome: Separate blob upload from metadata commit, handle concurrent edits/deletes, and synchronize devices with replayable cursors.

title: Production practice: service objectives, security, and safe evolution
prerequisite: At least three completed design modules
book: Chapter 1 and chapter wrap-ups; extended with production engineering
outcome: Turn a diagram into measurable service behavior, bounded failure recovery, threat boundaries, and a reversible migration plan.

title: Transfer assessment and graduation evidence
book: Apply Volume 1 mechanisms to non-book prompts; no Volume 2 required
outcome: Demonstrate unaided reasoning on three different problem families and review a real architecture from evidence.
